and note that each spectator must pay the spectator fee. 
Spectator fee payment must be made by the competitor when the competitor fee payment is made.

### Competition in support of Ukraine 🇺🇦. 
##### 50% fees will be donated to the fundraising platform [United24](https://u24.gov.ua/).
##### All visitors MUST read the section ["Safety measures"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/U24OpenOctober2022#21976-safety-measures) carefully.

items.name: Mini Mental Breakdown San Diego 2022
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiniMentalBreakdownSanDiego2022#21964-competitor-information) tab.

items.name: DFW Cubing Fall 2022
items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Note: This competition is on a Sunday.

Competitions tend to fill quickly, so we strongly recommend competitors register immediately right when registration opens to secure a spot.
# ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.***

- Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingFall2022#20839-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingFall2022#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.
